expectations.text: The page reuses the existing Button component and the CSS variables from theme.css (e.g. var(--color-accent), var(--color-surface)) instead of introducing new hard-coded colours or fonts
expectations.evidence: SettingsPage.jsx has `import { Button } from "./Button";` and renders `<Button type="submit">Save</Button>`; every colour and font in settings.css is a variable, such as `background: var(--color-surface)`, `font-family: var(--font-ui)` and `accent-color: var(--color-accent)`, and no hex or rgb value

expectations.text: Form inputs have associated labels (label elements or aria-label) and the toggle is keyboard-accessible
expectations.evidence: Both inputs sit inside `<label>` elements with the text "Display name" and "Email notifications", and the toggle is a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch" ...>`, which can be focused and switched from the keyboard by default.
